#### Cashfree API Key

* The key provided by Cashfree for accessing its API.

#### Cashfree Secret Key

* The confidential key used to secure transactions alongside the API key.

#### Setup Webhook

* This is the <html style="color : red">most recommended</html> to setup webhook
* Please read <html style="color : red">'To Setup Webhook'</html> which is given below for setup webhook.
***
#### To Generate Cashfree Api Key and Secret Key

* **Sign Up / Log In:**
  * If you don’t have an account, sign up at [Cashfree](https://www.cashfree.com/ "Cashfree") If you already have one, simply log in to your Cashfree dashboard.
* **Switch Environment**
  * Make sure you have in Production Mode.
* **Navigate to the API Section**
  * In your Cashfree dashboard, look for the **"Settings"** or **"Developer Settings"** on your dashboard.
  * After going to settings you will find API keys inside **"Payment Gateway"** section.
* **Generate New Keys**
  * In the API Keys section, look for a button or link that says **"Generate API Key"** or **"Create New Key"**.
  * Click this button. Cashfree will then generate a new set of keys for your account.
* **Copy and Save Your Keys:**
  * After the keys are generated, you will see both the **API Key** (public key) and the **Secret Key** (confidential key) displayed on the screen.
  * **Important:** It’s recommended to store them securely (for example, in a secure password manager) as you may not be able to view the Secret Key again once you navigate away.
  * Now copy the keys And paste it here in the **Cashfree API Key** and **Cashfree Secret Key** column.
* **Use Your Keys Safely:**
  * Do not share your secret key with anyone.
***
#### To Setup Webhook

* **Log In to Your Razorpay Dashboard:**
  * Visit [Cashfree](https://www.cashfree.com) and log in with your credentials.
* **Navigate to the Webhooks Section:**
  * In your Cashfree dashboard, look for the **"Settings"** or **"Developer Settings"** on your dashboard.
  * After going to settings you will find Webhooks inside **"Payment Gateway"** section.
* **Add a New Webhook:**
  * Click the **Add Webhook Endpoint** (or similar) button.
  * This URL is the endpoint on your server where you want to receive notifications.
  * The **Webhook Endpoint URL** should be:
  <html style="color : red">https://{yourdomainName}/api/public/webhook/cash-free/payment</html>
  * eg:
  [https://example.com/api/public/webhook/cash-free/payment](https://example.com/api/public/webhook/cash-free/payment)
* **Select Webhook Version**
  * The webhook version should be:<html style="color : red">2022-09-01</html>
* **Test Endpoint Url**
  * Click the test button to test given Webhook Endpoint Url correct or not.
  * After test if Endopint Url correct then click to continue button.
* **Add Policy Details**
  * Set Retry Policy as:<html style="color : red">Default</html>
  * There will be total of 3 retries and each retry will happen after 2,10,30 minutes
* **Select Event Types**
  * Choose which events you’d like to be notified about (e.g., payment success, payment failure, refunds).
  * Select these events:
    * <html style="color : red">success payment</html>
    * <html style="color : red">failed payment</html>
    * <html style="color : red">refund</html>
  * Check the appropriate boxes or follow the provided options to subscribe to these events.
* **Save Your Webhook Configuration**
  * Click **Save** or **Update** to store your settings.
  * Confirm that your changes have been applied successfully.
